+def pose_ik(model, qpos_template, qseed, qidx, dofidx, site_id, goal_p, goal_R):
+    """Damped least-squares arm IK on a private MuJoCo data object."""
+    d = mujoco.MjData(model)
+    d.qpos[:] = qpos_template
+    d.qvel[:] = 0
+    qseed = np.asarray(qseed, dtype=float).copy()
+    limits = np.array([model.jnt_range[model.joint(f"robot0_joint{i}").id] for i in range(1, 8)])
+    q = qseed.copy()
+    jp = np.zeros((3, model.nv))
+    jr = np.zeros((3, model.nv))
+    for _ in range(250):
+        d.qpos[qidx] = q
+        mujoco.mj_forward(model, d)
+        p = d.site_xpos[site_id].copy()
+        R = d.site_xmat[site_id].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+        ep = np.asarray(goal_p) - p
+        er = Rotation.from_matrix(goal_R @ R.T).as_rotvec()
+        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.0015 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.025:
+            break
+        mujoco.mj_jacSite(model, d, jp, jr, site_id)
+        J = np.vstack((jp[:, dofidx], 0.45 * jr[:, dofidx]))
+        e = np.concatenate((ep, 0.45 * er))
+        lam = 0.035
+        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + lam * lam * np.eye(6), e)
+        # Keep the redundant arm degree of freedom near the incoming configuration.
+        Jpinv = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + lam * lam * np.eye(6), J)
+        dq += 0.035 * (np.eye(7) - Jpinv) @ (qseed - q)
+        scale = min(1.0, 0.12 / max(np.max(np.abs(dq)), 1e-9))
+        q = np.clip(q + scale * dq, limits[:, 0] + 0.015, limits[:, 1] - 0.015)
+    d.qpos[qidx] = q
+    mujoco.mj_forward(model, d)
+    p = d.site_xpos[site_id].copy()
+    R = d.site_xmat[site_id].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+    pos_err = np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(goal_p) - p)
+    rot_err = np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(goal_R @ R.T).as_rotvec())
+    return q, pos_err, rot_err
+
+
+def main():

+    path = [

+        np.array([p0[0], button[1], p0[2]]),
+        np.array([2.64, button[1], p0[2]]),

+

+    joint_path = []
+    qseed = q0.copy()
+    pseed = p0.copy()

+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(waypoint - pseed) / 0.04)))
+        for t in np.linspace(1 / n, 1.0, n):
+            p = pseed + t * (waypoint - pseed)
+            q, pe, re = pose_ik(m, d.qpos.copy(), qseed, qidx, dofidx, site_id, p, R0)

+    previous = q0.copy()

+    print("after press", s.check(), "eef", d.site_xpos[site_id].copy(), "button", button)
